name: StickT2 User Demo
interpretation: Published SPI mode is DOUT (3), but stored digest matches the exact same bootloader with only that byte changed to DIO (2). This identifies a stale embedded digest relative to the published header; it is not a segment/padding parser mismatch. It does not prove which upstream packaging step changed the byte or whether real hardware boots. Original file is retained by URL/hash only and is never modified.
initialProbe: The initial aggregate verifier aborted without an ID; subsequent targeted checks identified StickT2. Other 30 image internal digests were not systematically rechecked.
redactions: Machine-specific traceback paths were not retained.
